text: The secret-import wrapper guards !res while computing failure, then later enters if (!res || !res.importedKeys) and reads res.errorMsg inside that branch. Recommend checking every later use when making an import result nullable; a prior || guard protects only its own expression. This is a scoped static concern, not a confirmed Thunderbird failure, because no throwing or undefined-result execution was run. This is static source and test-code inspection. title: A short-circuit result guard does not protect later dereferences
